book.name: FILIPAI
book.title: Pol nember tup nal lenge Filipai

content: Ya murp ŋoihmbwaip ilyeh, topoꞌe ya mikirh mane lenge mitiŋ lalme
Krais si ŋende bongolme yip, topoꞌe kin si ŋende nihararme yip, topoꞌe yip yikirh mane lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ. Yip lalme jahilyeh yarp yoto Yohe Yirise. Topoꞌe Krais ŋoihginirme yip.

Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam misilih yip ŋaiye pa lalme ŋoihmbwaip ilyeh, topoꞌe pa junde yaŋah ŋaiye yende niharar lenge mitiŋ, topoꞌe yip pa ŋoiheryembe ilyeh. Ŋaiye pa yende tuꞌe luku pe, ka ende ŋam ma hriphrip ŋembere.
Ŋupe ŋaiye pa yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe pe, yukur pa ŋoiheryembe yip tip, topoꞌe yahraꞌe naŋ yip tip, na pakai. Pa syumbe yurp ŋumwaiye yi yoto tuwihe yahraꞌe naŋ lenge mitiŋ.
Prepwan ŋaiye pa ŋoiheryembe laip yiptip ilyehme. Kut ŋoiheryembe laip lenge mitiŋ topoꞌe.
Pa tule yip tip tuꞌe Krais
Ŋoihmbwaip yip ka ŋahilyeh tuꞌe Jisas Krais.

content.text: Kom kin yukur ŋututus lenge ŋaiye ka yaŋaꞌe naŋ embere
yilme kin ŋahilyeh tuꞌe Got ŋaiye nambaꞌe.
Kut kin nasme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore luku pe,
kin nate gah taꞌe ŋaiye miyeꞌ wah pakaiye,
topoꞌe ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye miyeꞌ kekep.
Ki tale kitikin narp ŋumwaiye ŋasande wusyep Got
ŋaiye ka ole tuꞌe ŋaiye miyeꞌ endei nule nal loutungwarmbe.
Taꞌe luku pe, Got ŋahraꞌe kin nenge nanah luh ŋaiye nanah hlaꞌ pe,
kin naŋaꞌe naŋ embere nanah hlaꞌ ŋaiye taharꞌe naŋ lalme.
Topoꞌe nato naŋ Jisas pe, lenge mitiŋ lalme
ŋaiye yarp ya yanah moihlaꞌ, gah kekep,
topoꞌe ŋaiye yarp moi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge
ŋaiye si yule ka yasarꞌe ŋimbep me kin.
Mut lalme tinge ka yahraꞌe yininge nange
topoꞌe tinge ka yaŋaꞌe naŋ embere yilme Yai Got.

content: Poi ya murp tuꞌe yirise ŋaiye naŋarꞌe nal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge

Taꞌe luku pe, lenge ŋemei ŋam, ŋahilyeh ŋaiye nye nyermbe yip jande wusyep ŋam ŋaiye ŋam marp motop yip pe, ki bwore ŋaiye tukwini pa junde wusyep ŋam, ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam marp wohme yip. Tule yip tip yurp tuwihme Got pe, pa yisyunde wusyep Got. Yip pa ŋoiheryembe bworerme, topoꞌe pa yende wah nihe ŋaiye pa yambaꞌe laip bwore ŋaiye pa yurp nye nyermbe.
Hei, Got ŋende wah nato ŋoihmbwaip meleꞌe yip pe, kin ŋahraꞌe ŋoihmbwaip yip, ŋaiye pa yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe junde ŋasande kin. Taꞌe luku pe, se ka yul yip bongol ŋaiye pa yende ŋai uku.
Ŋaimune ŋaiye pa yende pe, pa syumbe yurp ŋumwaiye. Yukur pa yininge wusyep sekete, topoꞌe ŋaiye pa yonombe teketenge.

Ŋainde pupwa yukur ka si e oto yip, pakai. Yip pa yurp talah bwore bwarme tikin Got. Pe pa yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore juh bumbe me lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pupwa ŋaiye si ŋoihsipe ŋoiheryembe bwore. Yip pa yaŋarꞌe tuꞌe nowas ŋaiye naŋarꞌe nalꞌe nalꞌe kekep ŋaiye yepelmbe sekete.

Taꞌe luku pe, yip pa yini lenge wusyep ŋaiye Got tatame ka ungwis lenge ka yurp nye nyermbe. Ŋaiye pa yende tuꞌe luku pe, ŋam se ma hriphrip me yip dindiꞌ ŋup tikin Krais ŋaiye ka ot. Luku ka sasambe nange wah nihe ŋam yukur nal luh paka pakaiye.

Ŋaiye lenge Rom ka pumbe ma mule no, wim ŋam ka turuꞌ e tus pe, ka tuꞌe ŋaiye lenge pris yuruꞌe pinip wain ŋupe ŋaiye tinge yende ofa yalme Got, topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip yip ŋaiye teŋeime Krais bongol, ki taꞌe ŋaiye ofa yip yende yalme Got, kom ma hriphrip topoꞌme yip.
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋai uku ŋaiye ka ot pe, prepwan ŋaiye pa ŋoihmbwaip mane. Pa hriphrip topoꞌme ŋam.
Pol ŋanange ŋaiye ka ember Timoti el Filipai
Ŋaiye ŋasande tikin Lahmborenge Jisas pe, sehei woh ma member Timoti ka otme yip. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋupe ŋaiye ka plihe enge wusyep ote ini ŋam me yarp yip pe, luku ka ende bongolme ŋam.
Yukur miyeꞌ ende ŋoihginirme yip, topoꞌe ŋende nihararme yip taꞌe Timoti.
Lenge mitiŋ lalme tinge ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye ka yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe tititinge ilyeh ilyeh tongonose, kut yukur tinge ŋoiheryembe ŋaimune ŋaiye Jisas Krais ŋasande.
Topoꞌe yip lalme si sisyeme wah bwore ŋaiye Timoti ŋende nungwisme ŋam ŋaiye ŋam malaŋatme wusyep bwore mise. Bwore mise, kin nungwisme ŋam taꞌe ŋaiye talah nungwisme yai kin.
Ŋam de ma member kin ka ot me yip hihwaiye, ŋupe ŋaiye ma musyunde ŋaimune ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ embep Rom ka yende me ŋam.
Topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip ŋam teŋeime Lahmborenge bongol pe, ka se ende ŋahwikin ŋaiye ma muta metekeꞌ yip hihwaiye.
Pol ŋanange nange ka ember Epafroditus el Filipai

Ŋam da member Epafroditus ka plihe elme yip. Kin toꞌ poi, topoꞌe wah ilyeh poi, topoꞌe miyeꞌ yaŋam ŋam ŋaiye poi hindi mende wah taꞌe miyeꞌ wondoh tikin Got. Pe yip yember kin nat ŋaiye ka ungwisme ŋam.
Kin ŋasande tikin ŋaiye ka etekeꞌe yip lalme, topoꞌe kin garnge ŋaiye pa yusyunde nange kin ŋende wahriꞌ epwa.
Kin ŋende wahriꞌ epwa ŋembere pe, sehei kin de ka ole, kom Got ŋoihginirme kin pe, kin nungwisme kin. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam hriphrip. Detale, yukur kin plihe pwale ŋoihmbwaip mane nanah hlaꞌ.
Taꞌe pe, ŋam masande tikin ŋaiye ma member kin ka ot me yip no, yip pa plihe hriphrip ŋupe ŋaiye pa yetekeꞌe kin. Pe ŋoihmbwaip mane ŋam ka huhwai.
Pa hriphrip yambaꞌe kin tuꞌe toꞌ yip, detale, ŋoihmbwaip yip lalme teŋeime Lahmborenge. Pa yahraꞌe naŋ lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye ŋahilyeh taꞌe Epafroditus.
Detale, sehei kin de ka ole e oto wah tikin Krais, ŋupe ŋaiye kin nungwisme ŋam ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe, ŋaiye yip yukur tatame pa yende. Detale, yip yarp wohe.
